newsitem.title: USA: AFL-CIO criticizes Fed decision to raise rates.
newsitem.headline: AFL-CIO criticizes Fed decision to raise rates.

text.p: The AFL-CIO criticized the Federal Reserve Board decision to raise interest rates, saying it "sacrified the economic interests of America's working families.

"Let there be no misunderstanding, a hike in interest rates means real economic pain for working Americans. They will pay higher rates on their consumer and mortgage debt," AFL-CIO President John Sweeney said in a statement.

The central bank increased interest rates for the first time in more than two years, bumping up its target for the federal funds rate commercial banks charge each other for overnight loans to 5.5 percent from 5.25 percent.
